senses.gloss: [पञ्च् PAÑC, spread out, manifest].
पञ्च pañca, ˚— = पञ्चन् pañcan.

पञ्चन् páñc-an (or -án), a. pl. five;
 T. of the 🞄143th Lambaka in the Kathāsaritsāgara.

पञ्चाल pañcālá, m. pl. N. of a people and of 🞄a dynasty;
 ī, f. doll.
पञ्चावयव pañca‿avayava, a. five-limbed.
पञ्चिन् pañc-in, a. consisting of five parts.
पञ्चीकरण pañcī-karaṇa, n. reduction to five, 🞄combination with the five subtle elements.
पञ्चीकृ pañcī-kṛ, reduce to five, combine 🞄a gross element with all the five subtile elements.

पञ्चेषु pañca‿iṣu, m. (five-arrowed), Kāma;
 🞄-ūna, a. less by five.
पञ्जक pañja-ka, m. N..
पञ्जिका pañj-ikā, f. commentary explaining 🞄and analysing every word.
पाञ्चालिका pāñcāl-ikā, f. doll.
पाञ्चिग्राम pāñci-grāma, m. N. of a village.
पञ्चपदी pañca-padī, f. add — na dīyate, 🞄does not accompany him even five steps.
